title: Lanterns seems like a leftover from the old DCU.
summary: The Damon Lindelof-headed ( Lost , The Leftovers , Watchmen ) series is clearly grounded in crime and noir and eschews the brighter, quippier vibe of modern DCU properties under the leadership of Tim Peter Safran and James Gunn.
